task_instance: Perform dimensional analysis on a small 2-file sample DeFi codebase (PriceOracle.sol + VaultMath.sol) with a real unit-scaling bug: scan for arithmetic files, discover a dimensional vocabulary (tok/UoA/shr with D18/D8/D26 precision prefixes), annotate anchor points and propagate them through arithmetic, and detect the injected dimensional mismatch bug (multiplying an 18-decimal token amount by an 8-decimal oracle price without rescaling back down, producing a 1e8x overvaluation).
blocker_detail: The skill's specified architecture requires spawning specialized subagents (arithmetic-scanner, dimension-discoverer, dimension-annotator, dimension-propagator, dimension-validator) via a 'Task' tool, and this runtime's tool list has no such Task/subagent-spawning tool (only TaskStop, for stopping background tasks, was available). This did not block the core deliverable: I performed the four pipeline steps directly in a single agent context and still produced the same artifacts the skill specifies, so this is noted as a workaround rather than a blocker.
evidence: Created sample_defi/contracts/{PriceOracle.sol,VaultMath.sol} with a deliberately injected dimensional bug (amount*price never rescaled). Produced DIMENSIONAL_SCOPE.json (in_scope_files with per-file step2/step3/step4 status, all reaching terminal ANNOTATED/PROPAGATED-or-REVIEWED/VALIDATED states) and DIMENSIONAL_UNITS.md (Base Units: tok, UoA, shr; Derived Units: UoA/tok; Precision Prefixes: D18/D8/D26) in the project root, matching the skill's required schema. Annotated both .sol files in place with anchor (D8{UoA/tok} on the oracle) and propagated (D18{tok}, D26{UoA}, D18{shr}) unit comments. Ran validation reasoning and recorded finding DIM-001 (CRITICAL): usdValue() multiplies a D18{tok} amount by a D8{UoA/tok} price and returns the raw D26{UoA} product instead of rescaling to D18{UoA}, an off-by-1e8 valuation bug, with the fix (divide by 1e8) documented inline and in FINAL_REPORT.json. Verified both JSON artifacts parse cleanly with `python3 -m json.tool` (SCOPE_OK / REPORT_OK) and inspected the final annotated source files with `cat`. All files are under sample_defi/ and FINAL_REPORT.json in the work directory.
